```{r}
library(hBayesDM)
```
```{r}
full_stress.data <- "full_data_high_ss1.txt"
full_nostress.data <- "full_data_low_ss1.txt"
B1_stress.data <- "env1_data_high_ss1.txt"
B1_nostress.data <- "env1_data_low_ss1.txt"
B2_stress.data <- "env2_data_high_ss2.txt"
B2_nostress.data <- "env2_data_low_ss2.txt"
B3_stress.data <- "env3_data_high_ss3.txt"
B3_nostress.data <- "env3_data_low_ss4.txt"
B4_stress.data <- "env4_data_high_ss4.txt"
B4_nostress.data <- "env4_data_low_ss4.txt"
```
```{r}
model4.full_stress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = full_stress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.full_stress, file = "model4.full_stress.rds")
model4.full_nostress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = full_nostress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.full_nostress, file = "model4.full_nostress.rds")

model4.env1_stress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B1_stress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env1_stress, file = "model4.env1_stress.rds")
model4.env1_nostress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B1_nostress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env1_nostress, file = "model4.env1_nostress.rds")
```
```{r}
model4.env2_stress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B2_stress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env2_stress, file = "model4.env2_stress.rds")
model4.env2_nostress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B2_nostress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env2_nostress, file = "model4.env2_nostress.rds")

model4.env3_stress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B3_stress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env3_stress, file = "model4.env3_stress.rds")
model4.env3_nostress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B3_nostress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env3_nostress, file = "model4.env3_nostress.rds")

model4.env4_stress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B4_stress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env4_stress, file = "model4.env4_stress.rds")
model4.env4_nostress <- banditNarm_lapse(data = B4_nostress.data, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 8)
saveRDS(model4.env4_nostress, file = "model4.env4_nostress.rds")
```
```{r}
plot(model4.env4_nostress, type="trace")
```
```{r}
rhat_full_stress = rhat(model4.env4_stress)
write.csv(rhat_full_stress, "rhat_env4_stress.csv", row.names = TRUE)
rhat_full_nostress = rhat(model4.env4_nostress)
write.csv(rhat_full_nostress, "rhat_env4_nostress.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
```{r}
write.csv(model4.env4_stress$allIndPars, "individual_parameters_env4_stress.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(model4.env4_nostress$allIndPars, "individual_parameters_env4_nostress.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r}
waic1 = printFit(model4.full_stress, model4.full_nostress, model4.env1_stress, model4.env1_nostress, model4.env2_stress, model4.env2_nostress, model4.env3_stress, model4.env3_nostress, model4.env4_stress, model4.env4_nostress)
write.csv(waic1, "looic_stress_split.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
